10000 = 10 секунд
form.floodHint: Пауза между двумя сообщениями одного и того же участника в секундах. Более строгий из этого и значение группы применяется; модераторы обходят контроль за наводнениями.

upload.title: Upload a plugin
upload.body: The package (.zip) is checked before anything else: size, paths, manifest, compatibility, dependencies, migrations and signature. It is installed only after you confirm.
upload.hint: Maximum 8 MB. For an update, upload the new version of the same plugin.

capabilities.none: The plugin asks for no capabilities.

db.title: Own database
db.body: Creates tables in a separate schema, with a dedicated PostgreSQL role. It cannot read or change the site's tables.

events.title: Events
events.body: Learns when something happens on the site (new post, new member, chat message) and reacts in the background.

filters.title: Filters before saving
filters.body: Can change or reject posts before they are saved.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.body: Adds widgets you can place on pages with “Edit page”.

pages.title: Site pages
pages.body: Has its own pages on the site (addresses /p/…).

api.title: API routes
api.body: Receives JSON requests from the browser (addresses /api/plugins/…).

acp.title: ACP pages
acp.body: Has its own pages in the admin panel.

menus.title: Menus
menus.body: Adds links to the site menu or the user menu.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.body: Runs periodic or on-demand tasks in the background.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Has its own settings, editable in the ACP.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Declares group permissions, shown in ACP → Groups.

hooks.title: Extension points
hooks.body: Adds content to specific places in the interface (e.g. the author card).

http-out.title: Requests to other sites
http-out.body: Can send requests to external services, so it can send out the data it sees. Internal addresses are blocked.

client-css.title: CSS styles
client-css.body: Brings its own CSS, confined to the plugin's container (it does not change the rest of the site).

client-js.title: JavaScript in the browser
client-js.body: Runs JavaScript in visitors' browsers on the plugin's pages and can act on their behalf. Signed plugins only.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Reserved: the plugin's templates, for the template engine.

importer.title: Import from another platform
importer.description: Move an existing community to GamingCommunitySuite: members, groups, forums, topics, posts, private messages. Old passwords and addresses keep working.

connection.title: Old database
connection.hint: MySQL or MariaDB, used read-only. The password is stored encrypted and can be deleted after the import.
connection.passwordSet: Set. Leave empty to keep it.
connection.prefixHint: Empty if the tables have no prefix (e.g. ibf_ or xf_). The schema is detected automatically.
connection.filesPathHint: Root of the old site (with uploads/ or data/ and internal_data/), mounted read-only.
connection.filesUrlHint: Public address of the old site. Attachments in internal_data/ need the mounted folder.
connection.oldUrlHint: E.g. https://forum.example.com/forum. Used for internal links in posts and for the 301 redirects.

detected.unsupported: Update the old platform to a supported version first: core_* schema 4.4–4.7 or 5.x, xf_* schema 2.1–2.3.

options.title: What to import
options.hint: An account with the same email as an existing one is linked to it, not duplicated.
options.noFiles: Without the old files, attachments and avatars are not copied.
options.dryRunHint: Counts the records and checks a content sample without writing anything to the site.
options.redirects: Turn on the 301 redirects at the end
options.redirectsHint: Old addresses of topics, forums, members and posts lead to the new ones.

progress.title: Import running
progress.cancelConfirm: Cancel the import? What was already imported stays on the site.
progress.stale: The worker stopped reporting progress. Check the gcs-worker service, then resume the import.

report.title: Import report
report.deleteConfirm: Delete this import? The imported data and the redirects stay.
report.linked: Accounts that will be linked by email: {count}
report.sample: Conversion sample: {sampled} posts, {unrecognized} with unrecognized elements, {fallbacks} kept as plain text only

redirects.title: 301 redirects
redirects.hint: Addresses of the old site (topics, forums, members, posts) lead to the new ones with a 301, so search rankings stay.
redirects.prefixHint: E.g. /forum if the old forum lived in a subfolder; empty for the root.
redirects.noMatch: No new address for this address.
redirects.keepNote: Deleting the import from the ACP does not delete the imported data or the redirects.

errors.mysql: The connection to the old database failed ({code}). Check the server, port, user and password.
errors.schema_not_detected: No known schema in this database. Check the database name and the table prefix.
errors.version_unsupported: The old platform version is not supported. Update it to a supported version first.
errors.secret_unreadable: The saved password can no longer be read (the application secret changed). Enter it again.

reasons.version_unsupported: The old platform version is not supported.
